        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(outputStream);
        TaskF solver = new TaskF();
        solver.solve(1, in, out);
        out.close();
    }

    static class TaskF {
        int MAX = (int) (1e9);

        public void solve(int testNumber, InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
            int N = in.nextInt();
            int k = in.nextInt();
            ArrayList<int[]> interval = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                interval.add(new int[]{in.nextInt(), in.nextInt()});
            }
            interval.add(new int[]{2 * N, 2 * N});
            int cur = 0;
            SegmentTree[] dp = new SegmentTree[2]; //how many sides are fried on the front, 0 is currently on front, 1 is currently on back
            dp[0] = new SegmentTree(N + 1);
            dp[1] = new SegmentTree(N + 1);
            dp[0].assign(0, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < interval.size(); i++) {

                        } else {

                        }
                        put[z] = Math.min(twoSwaps + 2, Math.min(oneSwap + 1, noSwap));
                    }

                    dp[1].assign(j, put[1]);
                }

                size = N;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4 * N; i++) {

                }

                    }

                    a >>= 1;
                }
            }

            int getVal(int i) {
                if (i < 0) {
                    return MAX;
                }
                return arr[i];
            }

        }

    }

            return tokenizer.nextToken();

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

    }

            public int query(int l, int r) {
                if (r < 0) {
                    return MAX;
                }
                return queryUtil(1, 0, size - 1, Math.max(0, l), r);
            }

            public int queryUtil(int n, int tl, int tr, int l, int r) {
                //node number, cur range of node, cur range of query
                if (l > r) {
                    return MAX;
                }
                if (tl == l && tr == r) {
                    return tree[n];
                }
                int tm = (tl + tr) / 2;
                return Math.min(queryUtil(2 * n, tl, tm, l, Math.min(r, tm)), queryUtil(2 * n + 1, tm + 1, tr, Math.max(tm + 1, l), r));
            }

            public void assign(int n, int val) {
                arr[n] = val;
                int tl = 0;
                int tr = size - 1;
                int a = 1;
                while (tl < tr) {
                    int tm = (tl + tr) >> 1;
                    if (n <= tm) {
                        tr = tm;
                        a = 2 * a;
                    } else {
                        tl = tm + 1;
                        a = 2 * a + 1;
                    }
                }
                tree[a] = val;
                a >>= 1;
                while (a > 0) {
                    tree[a] = Math.min(tree[2 * a], tree[2 * a + 1]);
                    a >>= 1;
                }
            }

            int getVal(int i) {
                if (i < 0) {
                    return MAX;
                }
                return arr[i];
            }

            public int getMin() {
                return arr[0];
            }

            public int getMinUtil(int n, int tl, int tr) {
                if (tl == tr) {
                    return arr[tl];
                }
                int tm = (tl + tr) / 2;
                return Math.min(getMinUtil(2 * n, tl, tm), getMinUtil(2 * n + 1, tm + 1, tr));
            }

            public int[] getArray() {
                return arr;
            }

            public int getMinArray() {
                int min = MAX;
                for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                    min = Math.min(min, arr[i]);
                }
                return min;
            }

        }

    }

    static class InputReader {
        public BufferedReader reader;
        public StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream), 32768);
            tokenizer = null;
        }

        public String next() {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

    }
